title: Failure Injection Test Results
pdf_required_scenarios: 数据库主节点宕机 (DB primary down)
KMS 凭证失效 (KMS key rotated; cached credential stale)
Redis 队列不可用 (webhook delivery queue)
后台 cron 失败 (retention.py / cleanup_orphan_runs.py)
OAuth IdP 不可用 (hospital IdP down)
PHI 加密失败 (Fernet envelope key missing)
租户隔离越权 (cross-tenant access attempt)
审计写入失败 (audit_logs INSERT failed)

scenario_results.name: DB primary down
scenario_results.expected_behavior: uvicorn worker returns 503 Service Unavailable; health check fails; no orphan writes; fail-closed guard prevents audit_logs INSERT with NULL org_id
scenario_results.evidence: backend/app/services/fail_closed.py + A1A Gate 2 unit tests (test_audit_emit_fail_closed.py); live toxiproxy injection DEFERRED_TO_PILOT
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject via toxiproxy; verify uvicorn workers handle connection errors gracefully; verify no partial DB writes; verify fail-closed guard fires

scenario_results.name: DeepSeek unreachable (network partition)
scenario_results.expected_behavior: LLMGateway tenacity retry (3 attempts, 60s total); on final failure, agent_run status=failure, cost=0 (NOT NULL — Phase 7 Gate 4); audit_log row emitted; trace CaptureStatusEvent transition to CAPTURE_FAILED
scenario_results.evidence: icoder_runtime/core/llm_gateway.py + Phase 7 Gate 4 tests; Phase 7 Gate 12 prior PASS for client_credentials path; live injection DEFERRED_TO_PILOT
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject 60s+ timeout; verify retry budget exhausted; verify RunHistory status=failure; verify SSE emits ErrorEvent

scenario_results.name: LLM call timeout (> 60s)
scenario_results.expected_behavior: httpx 60s timeout triggers; tenacity retry; same as FI-02

scenario_results.name: DeepSeek 503 Service Unavailable
scenario_results.expected_behavior: tenacity retry on 5xx; after 3 attempts agent_run fails; same fail-handling as FI-02
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject 503; verify retry budget exhausted within 60s

scenario_results.name: LLM response truncation (finish_reason=length)
scenario_results.expected_behavior: DESIGN: response stored with finish_reason=length; audit_log details flag truncation; current IMPLEMENTATION does NOT explicitly detect truncation — Gate 4R-I open item
scenario_results.pilot_action: Add post-hoc validation: if finish_reason=length, retry with higher max_tokens; emit audit_log entry 'truncated_response_detected'

scenario_results.name: KMS key rotation (cached credential stale)
scenario_results.test_method: Rotate KMS key; attempt to use cached Fernet envelope
scenario_results.expected_behavior: DESIGN: CredentialVault.cache invalidation on key version change; current IMPLEMENTATION has NO invalidation signal — Gate 4R-I DESIGN
scenario_results.evidence: A1C.5 KMS_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md §4 (KMS key rotation + cache invalidation DESIGN)
scenario_results.pilot_action: Implement CredentialVault cache invalidation via KMS version token; add audit_log entry 'credential_rotated'

scenario_results.name: Redis webhook queue unavailable
scenario_results.expected_behavior: DESIGN: webhook delivery falls back to Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY; dead-letter queue if both fail
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject Redis outage; verify Postgres fallback; verify dead_letter_queue table INSERT

scenario_results.name: Disk full (FAISS index partition)
scenario_results.test_method: Fill disk to 99%; attempt to load FAISS index
scenario_results.expected_behavior: faiss.read_index raises OSError; health_check reports medcoder_index_ready=false; uvicorn workers continue serving other endpoints
scenario_results.evidence: backend/app/main.py:284-326 (M2.5 FAISS index health check fail-closed)
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject disk pressure; verify health_check flag flips; verify degraded mode (medical-coding agent fails gracefully)

scenario_results.name: Memory pressure (OOM)
scenario_results.expected_behavior: OOM killer terminates uvicorn worker; systemd restarts; 503 during restart window; health probe recovers within 30s
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject memory pressure; verify graceful worker restart

scenario_results.name: Background cron failure (retention.py)
scenario_results.test_method: Simulate DB outage during cron run
scenario_results.expected_behavior: cron emits audit_log row 'cron.retention.failed' with error_message; next run attempts resume; no data corruption
scenario_results.evidence: backend/app/services/retention.py + cleanup_orphan_runs.py — failure audit emit PRESENT; success audit emit PARTIAL (A1C.6 AUDIT_COMPLETENESS_REPORT §2 #15)
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject DB outage during cron; verify failure audit row; verify cron retry on next interval

scenario_results.name: OAuth IdP unavailable (hospital IdP down)
scenario_results.expected_behavior: All new login attempts return 503; existing JWTs continue to validate until expiry; SDK retries with backoff
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject IdP outage; verify 503; verify existing JWTs still work

scenario_results.name: API Client secret compromised
scenario_results.test_method: Use a known compromised secret; verify revocation
scenario_results.expected_behavior: Phase 7 Gate 5 disable/rotate endpoint revokes client; subsequent auth attempts return 401 invalid_client; audit_log row 'api_client.authentication_rejected' with reason='revoked'
scenario_results.evidence: Phase 7 Gate 5 clients.py disable + rotate endpoints + A1A Gate 1 OAuth audit event
scenario_results.pilot_action: Pilot env: rotate a test client; verify revoked secret rejected

scenario_results.name: PHI encryption failure (Fernet key missing)
scenario_results.test_method: Unset FERNET_KEY env var; attempt documents.submit
scenario_results.expected_behavior: documents.submit fails with 500 (fail-closed); no plaintext write to documents.encrypted_content; audit_log row 'documents.submit' with status=failure
scenario_results.pilot_action: Pilot env: unset FERNET_KEY; verify documents.submit fails; verify no plaintext leak

scenario_results.name: Cross-tenant access attempt
scenario_results.test_method: Hospital-A JWT attempts to read Hospital-B encounter_id
scenario_results.expected_behavior: tenant_read_policy visibility filter returns 404 Not Found (no leak); audit_log row 'tenant_isolation.violation_denied' with details.target_org_id
scenario_results.pilot_action: Pilot env: cross-tenant attack attempt; verify 404 + audit row

scenario_results.name: Audit log write failure (DB INSERT failed)
scenario_results.test_method: Simulate DB INSERT failure during audit_middleware
scenario_results.expected_behavior: fail-closed guard catches; transaction rolled back; primary action (e.g. documents.submit) ALSO fails — fail-closed prevents unaudited PHI write
scenario_results.evidence: A1A Gate 2 fail-closed guard + 4 write surfaces (record_run_start / log_action / acquire_or_replay / create_preview_session)
scenario_results.pilot_action: Pilot env: corrupt audit_logs table; verify dependent writes also fail

scenario_results.name: Sentry send failure (network partition)
scenario_results.expected_behavior: sentry-sdk buffers events in-memory + retries; if buffer full, drops oldest; no impact on primary app flow
scenario_results.pilot_action: Inject Sentry outage; verify app unaffected; verify buffered events deliver after recovery

scenario_results.name: SSE connection drop (proxy timeout)
scenario_results.expected_behavior: Client reconnects with Last-Event-ID header; server replays buffered events; if buffer expired, server emits catchup event
scenario_results.evidence: Phase 7 Gate 9 SSE endpoint + X-Accel-Buffering=no + backend/app/api/runs.py
scenario_results.pilot_action: Pilot env: force proxy timeout; verify client reconnect + replay

pilot_required_injections: Inject all 17 scenarios via toxiproxy on Pilot env
Verify 17 expected behaviors within 5-minute window each
Capture Sentry error events + Grafana metric spikes as evidence
Document actual vs expected deltas in PILOT_FAILURE_INJECTION_RESULTS.json
